description: Kyma — Colore: Biscuit & bronze Collezione: Armonia Codice: 5868 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Geometric Scala: Small Altezza: 55.12 cm Rapporto: 13.77 cm × 24.56 cm Toni: Brown KYMA draws its form from one of Chahan Minassian's Murano glass designs — a motif translated from molten material into a printed surface without losing the rhythm of its origin. The wave repeat creates a meditative continuity across any installation, while the vintage texture adds tactile depth that reads differently at close range than at distance: intimate on upholstery, atmospheri c on drapery. A fabric that softens structure and introduces quiet movement into a space. Part of the ARMONIA collection , designed in collaboration with Chahan Minassian.
